title: LePlanner: An Iterative Amortized Controller For World Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.13845v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models trained with joint-embedding predictive architectures learn compact, structured latent representations from physical interaction, yet planning in these latent spaces typically relies on one of two costly approaches. Search-based planners such as CEM, MPPI, and iCEM optimize action sequences through many predictor rollouts, achieving strong performance at the cost of high per-decision compute and latency. Policy-based methods amortize inference into a single forward pass but can degrade on contact-rich tasks where the demonstration distribution is multimodal. We propose LePlanner, an amortized iterative controller that learns to construct and refine latent action sequences through a frozen world-model predictor. LePlanner is trained with an arrival-and-hold objective that encourages the controller to reach the goal at the earliest feasible horizon and remain there. translated_title: LePlanner：一种用于世界模型的迭代摊销控制器
translated_abstract: 采用联合嵌入预测架构训练的世界模型能够从物理交互中学习到紧凑、结构化的潜在表示，然而在这些潜在空间中进行规划通常依赖于两种代价高昂的方法之一。基于搜索的规划器（如CEM、MPPI和iCEM）通过大量预测器 rollout 来优化动作序列，虽然性能强劲，但每次决策的计算成本和延迟都很高。基于策略的方法将推理摊销为单次前向传播，但在演示分布呈多模态的接触密集型任务上性能可能会下降。我们提出了LePlanner，这是一种摊销式迭代控制器，它学习通过冻结的世界模型预测器来构建和细化潜在动作序列。LePlanner使用“到达并保持”目标进行训练，该目标鼓励控制器在最早可行的时间范围内达到目标并保持在该状态。这解决了“时间范围重置拖延”这一失败模式（一种……）
tldr: LePlanner通过冻结的世界模型预测器学习构建和细化潜在动作序列，并采用“到达并保持”训练目标克服时间范围重置拖延问题，从而以单次前向传播的低成本实现了接近基于搜索规划器的性能。
en_tdlr: LePlanner is an amortized iterative controller that constructs and refines latent action sequences through a frozen world-model predictor, using an arrival-and-hold objective to overcome horizon-reset procrastination and achieve search-quality planning at a fraction of the computational cost.
